game_concept: A logic puzzle set in The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs, the castle dungeon stairwell: the baker's apprentice must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Reassign Relay: Overwrite a variable with a fresh value each round so the old number vanishes before goblin raiders can use it.
theme: The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs: the castle dungeon stairwell
core_gameplay_loop: Read the requested procedure, drag flowchart shapes into the chart, then run checks against example inputs and expected outputs.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the signal beacon using at most 16 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Drag blocks from the tray into chart positions. Drag them back to remove them. Check chart runs the algorithm. Keyboard: [ or ] selects a block, arrows choose a position, Enter places, C checks, Escape pauses.
win_condition: The signal beacon reached with actions_used <= 16.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 16 before the signal beacon is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 1: Controls and mission practice
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reassign Relay' (Week 1 slot 2), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Dungeon Stairs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wave_target changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Dungeon Stairs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The signal beacon reached with actions_used <= 16.
